datasets.title: Ecuador: Acute Food Insecurity Country Data
datasets.description: The IPC Acute Food Insecurity (IPC AFI) classification provides strategically relevant information to decision makers that focuses on short-term objectives to prevent, mitigate or decrease severe food insecurity that threatens lives or livelihoods. This data has been produced by the National IPC Technical Working Groups for IPC population estimates since 2017. All national population figures are based on official country population estimates. IPC estimates are those published in country IPC reports. There is also a global dataset .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ecuador-acute-food-insecurity-country-data]

lineage.description: The IPC Acute Food Insecurity classification was produced by Ecuador's National IPC Technical Working Group using the standardized IPC methodology to classify populations into five phases of food insecurity severity. Population estimates are based on official country census data and IPC technical assessments, with results disaggregated at national and sub-national (area/region) levels with validity periods and projections.

sources.name: National IPC Technical Working Group
sources.description: Official national food insecurity classification data produced by Ecuador's IPC Technical Working Group using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification methodology to assess acute food insecurity phases and affected populations.
